items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I remember many times when I first joined him... I asked Blue Mitchell... So I just played whatever I felt I wanted to play... I must say I enjoyed working with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, well my first trip to Australia was in 1973 with John Mayall. And in fact Blue Mitchell and Freddy Robinson, I don’t know if you’re familiar with these names—
I remember, did you make a record with him that had no drummer on it or something? I remember hearing a record of his, but I remember your name on it.
